title: Moma language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Moma is an Austronesian language spoken in Central Sulawesi, Indonesia. Historically, it is derived from the Kaili dialect cluster, but is divergent due to strong influence from Uma.
